observed_behavior: A genuine Vitest registration with a trailing numeric timeout was rejected as non-executable.
expected_behavior: The locator recognizes the callback before the timeout while retaining skip and todo exclusion.
causal_mechanism: The locator selected the last argument as the callback unconditionally; the timeout has no call signature.

anti_pattern.structural_description: One positional form was treated as the complete external overload contract.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: An optional trailing argument displaces the body without changing its executable role.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Callback selection accounts for the numeric timeout overload, including numeric unions.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Select the preceding argument when every constituent of the final argument type is numeric; retain callable-body and option checks.

applicability_conditions: Recognized runner registration with a numeric timeout after its callback
known_non_matches: Callback-last registrations, including options before the callback
confirmation_evidence: The focused regression rejected it('work', async () => {}, 300_000) before the repair and accepted the same registration afterward.
regression_proofs: tsts/test/traceability-graph.test.ts: Vitest timeout overloads retain executable test attachment
